name: Hinekuremono no Gakuen Seishun Monogatari ~Ore to Kanojo no Reversible~
original_name: 捻くれモノの学園青春物語 ～俺と彼女の裏表～
source:
Yuuichirou is a pessimistic guy who has practically no friends. He leads a life far from the dramatic ones depicted in manga and novels. However, even an anti-social person like him faced a crisis: his grades are awful and he won’t be able to move on without raising them. He was offered the opportunity to raise them in exchange for joining a certain club. It was a club full of boring, worthless, good-for-nothing students – the Seishun Club!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/12/16/december-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
雄一郎是个悲观男子，几乎没有朋友。他过着远离漫画与小说戏剧性人生的生活。然而，就连这种不善交际的人也遇到了危机：成绩糟糕，如果不提高就无法升学。有人向他提供机会，只要加入某个社团，就能提高成绩。那是一个充满无聊、无用、没出息学生的社团——青春部！

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/12/16/december-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]）
